decisions.statement: A file that is not text is held as base64 in a json file beside its page.
A carrier states the name a seam writes the bytes under.
A carrier states the byte count and the sha256 of the bytes that carrier has.
A carrier whose count or digest disagrees with its bytes is refused.
A json beside-file is judged by the entry ceiling rather than the file ceiling.
Nothing here writes the bytes anywhere.
Nothing is imported here, because a container stage runs this body on its own.

definition: how a file that is not text is in akasha as text beside its page
